# Harshit Arora

> Marketing, SEO and AI-content specialist based in Faridabad, Delhi NCR, India.
> B.Com (Hons) from JIMS Kalkaji (CGPA 9.3). Works at the intersection of technical
> SEO, GEO/AEO content and AI-driven content production workflows.
> Currently open to marketing, SEO and AI-content roles.

## Summary

Harshit Arora is a marketing graduate building a career in digital marketing, content
strategy and brand communication. His experience deliberately spans three different
worlds — healthcare marketing, B2B industrial sales, and campus media — on the premise
that you understand marketing better once you have seen how businesses actually sell,
not only how they communicate.

## Experience

- **Max Healthcare** — Industrial Trainee, Marketing (Feb 2026 – May 2026).
  Produced SEO- and AEO-optimised content using prompt engineering for diagnostic-test
  and hospital topics. Built content and automation workflows with Claude Skills,
  Custom GPTs and AI video production, covering generation, QA and performance analysis.
  Supported SEO strategy execution, Google Ads fundamentals and competitive benchmarking.
  Produced AI-assisted performance reports and backtested WhatsApp bot conversation flows.
- **Bajrang Industrial Hardware**, Faridabad — Sales & Marketing Associate (Apr 2025 – Jul 2025).
  Acquired and served B2B clients; coordinated wholesale hardware sales; supported brand
  visibility and customer-retention efforts.
- **CMR Green Technologies**, Faridabad — Finance & Taxation Intern (May 2022 – Jul 2022).
  Reconciled Form 26AS, AIS and TIS; worked on TDS/TCS returns (26Q, 27EQ) and Form 15CA
  for three entities; reviewed payables and supported Section 80JJA analysis.
- **JIMS Kalkaji, Campus Media** — Social Media Manager (Feb 2021 – Jun 2023).
  Ran official LinkedIn presence for Pixellence and Communicon; managed the institute's
  official Twitter handle for seven months.
